description: Add a NOT NULL column `last_login_ip` (VARCHAR(45)) to the `users` table on a production PostgreSQL 14 database. The table has approximately 50 million rows and receives ~8,000 writes/second during peak hours. Must backfill existing NULLs before applying the NOT NULL constraint. The change must be deployed during the maintenance window (Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC). Risk factors: long-running ALTER TABLE locking, insufficient disk space for WAL during backfill, application code referencing the table must be deployed simultaneously. Tools available: pt-online-schema-change (if needed), pgAdmin, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, rollout automation.
